Molecules break apart, recombine and transform into new compounds, releasing gases, soot and other carbon-rich particles into the air.

items.story: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. items.headline: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
items.teaser: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way…
items.story: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way. Because the stars trace the galaxy’s gravity, researchers used the stream to estimate how much invisible dark matter surrounds it and how that matter is distributed. The breakthrough offers astronomers a promising new way to investigate one of the universe’s greatest mysteries.
